020@HistoryLogProps(

025public class CgmBleCalibrationEvtG7HistoryLog extends HistoryLog {

031        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
032        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, isCalibrationAccepted);
033        this.isCalibrationAccepted = isCalibrationAccepted;

050    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
051        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
052        this.cargo = raw;
053        parseBase(raw);
054        this.isCalibrationAccepted = raw[10] != 0;

056
057    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, boolean isCalibrationAccepted) {
058        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
059            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(439, 0), // 439 = 0x01B7
060            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
